title: Differential aggregation views + telemetry-guided index recommendations for dashboard query API
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Several dashboard routes performing heavy time-windowed aggregations and top-k breakdowns are exhibiting high p95/p99 latency and CPU spikes for tenants with large event volumes. Current per-request scans + generic time-bucket indexes lead to unpredictable tail latency during bursts and cross-tenant noisy neighbors.

Goal: Reduce tail latency (p99) and CPU cost for aggregation-heavy dashboard APIs by introducing: (1) lightweight differential aggregation materialized views that maintain incremental deltas per tenant/time-bucket, and (2) a telemetry-guided index recommendation engine that proposes and optionally creates targeted indexes/materialized caches based on real query shape and cost-benefit analysis. Keep fallbacks conservative and preserve correctness for exact queries while offering an "approximate/fast" mode for exploratory UI uses.

Scope: Backend services and telemetry pipelines. No frontend UI changes required for initial rollout (server-side feature flag + metadata endpoint). Work spans query planner, storage for deltas, analytics telemetry, and safe rollout automation.
acceptance_criteria: Reduce dashboard p99 latency for targeted routes by >=40% on tenant workloads used in telemetry sample
Query planner can select differential view for supported query shapes transparently
Telemetry pipeline produces ranked index candidates with estimated benefit/cost and a confidence score
Server exposes a metadata endpoint with view/index status and staleness for console to surface in later UX work
Safe fallback to exact execution on view miss or when staleness exceeds threshold
work_notes: 2025-02-12 — Kickoff: scoped MVP for two routes: 'top-resources' and 'time-series-percentiles' (Aisha). Identified storage layout: tenant_id + hour bucket + delta payload (serialized aggregate + topN sketch).

2025-02-18 — Infra sync: Evan to prototype compact delta ingestion using existing events stream (kafka topic 'events-analytics') with consumer group isolation per workspace. Decided to use RocksDB-backed local stores for fast writes then periodic compaction to cold column store.

2025-02-22 — Telemetry plan: Add low-overhead sampling traces for dashboard queries (1-2% sample) capturing predicate shapes, cardinality estimates, observed row scans, execution cost and latency. Store aggregated telemetry in analytics cluster for offline candidate evaluation.
2025-02-25 — Design review: PM requested explicit API for 'freshness_window' and 'approximate=true' hint. Agreed to server-side feature flag to enable approximate mode per workspace first.

2025-02-27 — Spike results: Prototype differential view reduced CPU by ~35% and p99 by ~48% on synthetic heavy-tenant replay. Noted edge-case: joins across high-cardinality attributes cannot currently be accelerated by this pattern.

2025-03-01 — Implementation plan: Phase 1 (MVP): telemetry sampling + offline candidate generator + materialized delta store + planner hook that prefers view when predicates match. Phase 2: automated index create with 'dry-run' costing, operator approval, and rollback automation.
risks_and_mitigation: Storage growth: maintaining per-tenant deltas increases storage. Mitigation: TTL compaction, delta compaction, and size-based eviction policies; monitor storage per workspace and set soft limits.

Staleness vs correctness: approximate views may be stale. Mitigation: expose freshness metadata per view, allow query hint to request exact execution when freshness unacceptable, and conservative default to exact for monetary/contracted dashboards.
Operational complexity: more moving parts in ingestion and compaction. Mitigation: reuse existing event pipelines and monitoring; automate alerting for compaction backlog and consumer lag.
Index creation cost: creating bad indexes can increase write cost. Mitigation: require telemetry score threshold and dry-run cost estimation before create; operator approval for automatic creation.
Security/tenant isolation: ensure delta stores enforce tenant-level access controls. Mitigation: reuse existing RBAC and encryption-at-rest policies; add integration tests for tenant isolation.
implementation_plan: 1) Telemetry sampling: add lightweight instrumentation in query execution path (1-2% sample). Persist aggregated query signatures and cost metrics to analytics cluster (2w)
2) Offline candidate generator: batch job that consumes telemetry, groups signatures, simulates benefit of a differential view using replay (2w)
3) Delta store MVP: implement compact per-tenant/hour delta layout with fast append and compaction worker (3w)
4) Planner integration: add selector to prefer view when signature matches and staleness within configured threshold (1w)
5) Safe rollout: enable by workspace via feature flag, observe metrics, enable selective automated creation in later phase (2w)
6) Phase 2 automation: dry-run index creation, automated cost evaluation and a safe operator flow for auto-create/rollback (3w)
qa_and_validation: Unit + integration tests for delta ingestion, compaction, and planner selection logic
Backfill test: replay historical events into delta store and compare results vs exact queries for correctness across sample tenants
Performance bench: synthetic heavy-tenant replays to validate p95/p99 improvements and CPU savings
Chaos test: simulate compaction worker lag and verify graceful fallback to exact execution
next_steps: Assign owners for each subcomponent: telemetry (Evan), delta store (Priya), planner (Ethan)
Build telemetry schema and start sampling on non-prod (dev/stage) this week
Schedule infra quota review for delta store growth with SRE
Draft operator runbook for enabling/disabling approximate mode per workspace
comments: PM feedback (2025-02-25): We need clear UX hooks for freshness and an opt-out for enterprise tenants. Keep approximate mode opt-in at first.
Design feedback (2025-02-26): No UI required initially but please expose view metadata endpoint so we can add a tooltip in Console later explaining freshness.
Code review (2025-02-28): Prototype delta schema looks good; please add more unit tests around eviction and compaction boundary conditions.
SRE note (2025-03-01): Watch retention policies; alert if a workspace's delta_store crosses 10GB without compaction progress.
